# `company.shipment_draft_lines`

Immutable lines of a draft shipment.

Database: `company`.

| Column | SQL type | Nullable | Default | Key | Indexes | References | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | primary key 1 | — | — | Stable ULID of this line. |

| `line_identity` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | — | — | Stable identity the shipment line keeps when the draft ships. |
| `position` | INTEGER | no | — | unique with draft_id + position | — | — | One-based position. |
| `root_document_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | — | — | Billing root document of the order line. |
